actual: PR #2642 changed only one HMM design document and one BUG JSON, but AIstock CI run 29953296539 used BASE_SHA=cb77e7ab while the checked-out merge ref was merged into current main b97d8554. The generated changed_files.txt therefore contained 38 files from intervening main commits and incorrectly scheduled qe_read_backend and qe_long_trend_phase2_backend. Pull-request classification must derive the exact PR diff from the checked-out merge ref/current base and must not run modules absent from changed-file ownership unless an explicit dependency, shared contract, or cross-module acceptance item exists.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
